facts.business: Acme Resources Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending activities, sale of property, and other financial services.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpt
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding provisional attachment of inventory worth Rs.543.92 lakh by Income Tax Department (Rs.115.80 lakh released) and demand notices received totalling Rs.8,421.62 lakh for various assessment years, challenged before CIT(A).

key_risks: Regulatory changes by RBI and increasing compliance requirements
Interest rate fluctuations and monetary policy changes impacting cost of funds
Competition from banks, NBFCs, fintech and digital lending platforms
Adverse macroeconomic conditions and geopolitical uncertainties
Credit risk and asset quality concerns due to changes in customer repayment capacity
Liquidity constraints, cybersecurity risks, technological disruptions, and operational risks
Provisional attachment of inventory by Income Tax Department restricting transfer/sale
Significant tax demand notices totalling Rs.8,421.62 lakh under appeal
